name: obsidian-puddle-scanner
title: Scan Obsidian vault for tasks that could become puddle requests

specification.purpose: Search an Obsidian vault for open task lines and list them with the file each came from, as candidates for puddle requests.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.description: Folder inside the vault to search. Leave empty to search the whole vault.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Text that marks a candidate line. The default finds open task checkboxes.

specification.output: A list of matching lines, each with the path of the note it came from.

settings.name: vaultPath
settings.description: Absolute path of the Obsidian vault on the machine that runs the app.

reusabilityNote: Works on any Obsidian vault; the folder and query are inputs, the vault path is a setting.
